caption: The drawing depicts a single bronze or copper vessel with a rounded, bulbous body that tapers slightly at the top and bottom, featuring a broad rim and decorative molding near its upper section. The vessel has a high-arching handle attached at two points near the rim with circular, ornate loops. The surface of the vessel is rendered in shades of brown, greenish-blue, and copper, suggesting patina and aging, with greenish oxidation visible in several areas. The background is plain and cream-colored, with no additional objects or elements present. The artist’s and donor’s names, "Edward T. Jewett" and "Library H. Wadsworth," are printed in small text on the lower right of the image.
title: Holy-Water Bucket
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
